resources.string: To apply after reboot, vivo may also need auto-start allowed for this app.
The rms service is not reachable from this app on this build.
Apps that cap themselves at 120 fps run at half the pinned rate on a 165 Hz pin (82.5 fps). Give such apps a rate of their own, or Automatic to leave them to the app and vivo\'s own per-app setting.
App switching: off. Turn on vivo HiHz in the accessibility settings so the rate follows the app in front. If it is greyed out, open this app\'s info page, tap ⋮ and allow restricted settings first.
Sees which app is in front, and nothing else, to switch to the refresh rate set for it in vivo HiHz. Only which app owns each window is looked at; no window content is read.
How to see the app in front
Usage access: not allowed. Allow it for vivo HiHz.
Shizuku: running, but vivo HiHz is not allowed yet.
Shizuku: not running. Start it in the Shizuku app. After a reboot, start Shizuku again.
